25 But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you. (1 Peter 1:25 KJV)

Notice that the Word of God endures forever. This shows that the people, who are saying the Word is outdated and no longer applies to us, are very wrong. We can be assured that the Word of God is just as relevant to us today, as it was when it was written thousands of years ago. Godâ€™s Word does not change (Matthew 24:35).
